name: On-device ML runtime (Core ML, LiteRT)
plain: Runs trained models on the phone's neural hardware.
meaning: Developers ship models with the app and run them on CPU, GPU or the neural chip. NNAPI is deprecated in favour of LiteRT, which targets vendor accelerators.

android.api_surface: LiteRT (formerly TensorFlow Lite), LiteRT NPU delegate, NNAPI (deprecated in Android 15), MediaPipe
android.note: LiteRT Next adds vendor NPU accelerators (Qualcomm, MediaTek).

ios.api_surface: Core ML, MLX (macOS), Core ML Tools, BNNS Graph
ios.note: Core ML uses the Neural Engine automatically.

limits.headline: Can run trained AI models on your phone's own chip
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens inside the app when you use a smart feature
can: Run models for photos, speech or text using the phone's neural hardware
Use faster chips on some Android phones, like Qualcomm and MediaTek
cannot: Use the Neural Engine on iPhone by choice; the system handles it automatically
Run without a model the app brought along
Send your data to a server just because it uses this tool
limits.differs: iPhone uses Core ML, which picks the Neural Engine automatically. Android uses LiteRT, with extra support for some chip makers.

story.what_it_is: The built in engine that runs trained AI models on the phone's chips.

marketing.name: Core ML
marketing.pitch: Apple describes Core ML as the way to run machine learning models on device with the Neural Engine.

marketing.name: LiteRT
marketing.pitch: Google positions LiteRT as its on device runtime for fast, private machine learning.

story.for_you: You never see it. Face unlock, photo search and live camera effects run quickly and privately because a model is running on your phone.
story.for_makers: Makers ship a model inside the app and run it fast on special chips. This keeps data local and avoids server costs, though a model in the app can be copied.

use_cases.example: A game runs a smart opponent or upscaling model on the phone.
A photo app removes a background in real time.
A fitness app counts reps from the camera with no upload.
A banking app checks for face spoofing on device.
A music app recognizes a song or splits vocals.
An AR app tracks your hands and face live.
An ad model on the phone ranks which ads to show without sending data out.

story.android_note: LiteRT replaces NNAPI and adds chips from Qualcomm and MediaTek.
story.ios_note: Core ML uses the Neural Engine automatically.

abuse: Model theft from the app bundle
